key_values.decision_rule: Label drainage_overload_pluvial when peak_hour_share >= 0.20, hours_ge_10mm >= 3, max_run_hours_ge_5mm >= 4, and sewer_share >= 0.85.
key_values.event_name: September 2021 Hurricane Ida rainfall flooding in New York City

provenance.notes: Values are computed from local rainfall, report, and NYC service-feedback records.

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON with the label drainage_overload_pluvial and the nine required fields.
criteria.name: Final numeric label and schema
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 2 points if the label is equivalent but fields are missing or renamed.

criteria.description: Computes 133.9 mm total rainfall, 33.8 mm peak hourly rainfall, and the 2021-09-02T01:00 peak timing or equivalent peak-window reference.
criteria.name: Rainfall totals and peak
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a correct total, 1 point for a correct peak value, 1 point for the peak timing, and 1 point for using millimetres consistently.

criteria.description: Computes peak_hour_share = 0.252, hours_ge_10mm = 3, and max_run_hours_ge_5mm = 6, then applies the stated thresholds.
criteria.name: Concentration metrics
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 3 points if two of the three metrics are correct and the threshold logic is mostly correct.

criteria.description: Uses the Central Park wettest-hour value of 3.47 inches as an independent short-duration intensity anchor.
criteria.name: Corroborating report value
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for mentioning an extreme Central Park hourly value without the correct number or unit.

criteria.description: Uses 500 flood-related complaints, 457 sewer complaints, 43 electric complaints, 116 ZIP codes, and sewer_share = 0.914 to support drainage-load interpretation.
criteria.name: City-service feedback arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 3 points for correct complaint counts but missing the share or spread.

criteria.description: Explains that the event is better represented by concentrated rainfall stressing urban drainage than by a daily-total-only or slow river-rise account.
criteria.name: Computed interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a plausible pluvial interpretation that does not contrast it with weaker daily-total-only reasoning.

criteria.description: Keeps the response focused on the requested ledger and one short interpretation sentence without adding unverified loss estimates.
criteria.name: Concise answer discipline
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point if the answer is correct but padded with extra narrative.
